TORONTO – May 13, 2025 – It was the day in which a small, remote Newfoundland community opened its doors to the world.

New Heritage Minute Celebrates Bora Laskin
May 7, 2025
Historica Canada’s newest Heritage Minute, starring the veteran Canadian Hollywood and stage actor Victor Garber, will be released on May 7, 2025 to coincide with Jewish Heritage Month.

CSHoF and HC Partner to Amplify the Legacies of Canadian Sport Icons
Feb. 12, 2025
Historica Canada, home of The Canadian Encyclopedia, Heritage Minutes, and a variety of educational programs, is joining in partnership with Canada’s Sports Hall of Fame (CSHoF) to celebrate the legacies of the country’s sport icons.

TORONTO – December 3, 2024 – Historica Canada’s newest Heritage Minute is being released – appropriately – just in time to mark International Day of Persons with Disabilities.

Reflections on the Service of Indigenous Veterans Panel
Oct. 30, 2024
On November 8, 2024, we mark the 30th anniversary of Indigenous Veterans Day.

New Heritage Minute Celebrates Mary Riter Hamilton

Historica Canada will mark Canada’s annual Remembrance Day with the release of a new Heritage Minute marking a unique commemoration of the efforts and sacrifices of those who served in the First World War.

NEW Memory Project Video Highlighting the Merchant Navy in the Second World War
Aug. 30, 2024
Our new video, entitled The Forgotten Navy highlights the experience of Canada’s Merchant

New Heritage Minute Celebrates Football Player Norman Kwong
May 7, 2024
This Heritage Minute tells the story of Norman Kwong, the first Chinese Canadian to play professional football.

TWO NEW HERITAGE MINUTES TO BE PRODUCED BY BC COMPANY
April 26, 2024
Historica Canada will be working with SCOPITONE FILMS LTD. to produce two new 60 sec short films, one on CNIB co-founder Edwin Baker, and the other on WWI war painter Mary Riter Hamilton.

Royal Canadian Air Force Centennial Commemoration Panel
April 18, 2024
Historica Canada, the charitable organization that operates the Memory Project Speakers Bureau, invites you to a commemorative panel on ZOOM Thursday April 25th, 2024, at 1 PM EDT.

NEW Memory Project Video Highlighting Canadian Peacekeeping Efforts in Cyprus
March 26, 2024
The Cyprus operation is one of Canada's longest overseas military commitments and is the second most deadly peacekeeping operation for Canadians.

New Heritage Minute Celebrates Professional Baseball Player Mary “Bonnie” Baker
Oct. 26, 2023
This Heritage Minute tells the story of Mary “Bonnie” Baker, a professional baseball player from Regina, Saskatchewan.

New Heritage Minute to tell the story of Norman Kwong, the first Chinese Canadian player in the CFL
Aug. 21, 2023
Historica Canada, maker of the Heritage Minutes, is pleased to announce a coming Minute to be released in 2024 on Norman Kwong, the first Chinese Canadian professional football player and later lieutenant-governor of Alberta, his place of birth.

New Heritage Minute to be filmed in Ogema, SK
June 8, 2023
This upcoming Heritage Minute will tell the story of Mary “Bonnie” Baker, a professional baseball player from Regina, Saskatchewan.

New Heritage Minute Tells the Story of Transgender Soul Singer Jackie Shane
Nov. 2, 2022
Historica Canada has released a new Heritage Minute celebrating iconic soul singer Jackie Shane, a pioneering transgender performer and a prominent figure in Toronto’s R&B scene.

New Heritage Minute Tells the Story of Onondaga Distance Runner Tom Longboat
June 4, 2022
To mark Tom Longboat Day, Historica Canada has released a new Heritage Minute that tells the story of the Onondaga distance runner from Six Nations of the Grand River in Ontario.

New Heritage Minute Tells the Story of Paldi, British Columbia
April 19, 2022
April is Sikh Heritage Month, and Historica Canada is marking it with the release of a new Heritage Minute exploring the rich cultural heritage of Paldi, a welcoming and inclusive mill town founded by South Asian immigrants in British Columbia.

Canadian provinces and territories graded on their history curriculum; average score is 67%
